manifest.targetGame: Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour (Steam, English); extract into the game folder; overwrite when asked

files.reason: The AMD64 / Direct3D 11 Zero Hour runtime. Steam's Play button starts Generals.exe, so the runtime is shipped under that name.
files.replaces: REPLACES the original Electronic Arts launcher Generals.exe of the Steam installation (restore with Steam: Verify integrity of game files)

files.reason: Explains the preview, installation, limitations and restoration.
GPL-3.0-or-later with the Electronic Arts additional terms: required for redistributing the executable.

files.ownership: Microsoft redistributable (app-local deployment of the Visual C++ runtime)
